metric: Candidate first-top-out match points, 1 for a win, 0 for a loss, 0.5 for simultaneous losses, timeouts or nonterminal natural-lock censoring.
controls: Matched bags and fixed-tick hard-drop barrier. 170–250 ms reaction and 850 inputs/min for both seats.
interval: Whole-bag percentile bootstrap, 5000 draws, random seed 277159, 95% interval.
criterion: Lower interval endpoint above 0.5 on this cohort.
analysis: Compute the confirmatory result once after all 1600 games. Retain both earlier 200-bag panels. No interim analysis, tuning or outcome-dependent repetition.
